coverage.reason: Commit-scoped chat notifications and independently bounded held responses share the store transaction, cookie/session, current-realm and clan authorization paths. Real PostgreSQL tests verify rollback, edits/deletion, lost notifications, session/membership revocation, pool/admission independence and restricted permanent-service startup/shutdown. Existing store and access suites protect unrelated transactions and privacy; the selected chat emulator preserves authoritative send cooldown, idempotency, membership, moderation and retention rules. No gameplay or schema migration changes.

Shared browser transport gains coalesced foreground/network refresh and a separate authorized chat delivery loop. Source and exact-minifier tests exercise fallback, cancellation, account/channel isolation, old response ordering, disposal and bounded ordinary requests; the production artifact fixture checks delivery bytes and unchanged cache budget. Existing real PostgreSQL browser adapter tests cover shared read/write compatibility, and desktop plus two landscape visual suites preserve composer, focus, moderation, cooldown and duplicate handling. Translation is unchanged but consumes the same message events.
Documents the measured polling bottleneck, implemented transport bounds, validation limitations and separate protected-runtime rollout. No additional runtime behavior.
